title: 只用 that 的情况

examples.en: This is the best film that I have ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我看过的最好的电影。

examples.en: Everything that he said is true.

guess.question: 什么情况下只能用 that，不能用 which？

options.text: 先行词是不定代词、被最高级或序数词修饰、或人与物同时出现时
options.feedback: 对！这几种情况 that 是唯一选择，用 which 就扣分。
不对——人名指人，通常用 who。

options.text: 任何时候 which 都能代替 that
options.feedback: 不对——这几种特殊情况下 which 是不能用的。

rule.rule: 四种情况只用 that：① 先行词是不定代词（all / everything / nothing / something / anything / little / much）；② 先行词被最高级、序数词或 the only / the very 修饰；③ 先行词同时包含人和物；④ 主句是以 who / which 开头的特殊疑问句
rule.formula: ① All that he said is true.　② This is the best book that I have read.　③ He talked about the teachers and schools that he visited.　④ Who is the girl that is standing there?

anchors.en: This is the first book that I bought with my own money.
anchors.zh: 这是我用自己钱买的第一本书。

anchors.en: Everything that he told me is important.
anchors.zh: 他告诉我的一切都很重要。

trap.wrong: This is the best film which I have ever seen.
trap.right: This is the best film that I have ever seen.
trap.why: 先行词被最高级 best 修饰，只能用 that。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——不定代词、最高级、序数词、人与物同现，这四种只用 that。

check.stem: This is the most interesting story ____ I have ever heard.

options.distractor: 最高级修饰时只用 that
story 是物，且最高级要用 that

check.explanation: 最高级修饰先行词 → 只用 that。

check.stem: Everything ____ he said at the meeting was true.

options.distractor: 先行词是不定代词，只用 that

check.explanation: 先行词是不定代词 everything → 只用 that。

options.text: They talked about the people and places that they visited.
They talked about the people and places which they visited.
options.distractor: 人与物同时出现时只用 that

options.text: They talked about the people and places who they visited.
options.distractor: places 是物，不能只用 who

options.text: They talked about the people and places what they visited.

check.explanation: 先行词同时含人和物 → 只用 that。
